notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is in the governmental funds statement), so business_type is null. Basic statement lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p3-4); the government-wide Statement of Activities (p1-2) is not used for receipts. Beginning/ending cash = total fund balances rolled forward (11,242,539 to 23,053,384; p4). Transfers of 90,000 in/out net to zero in the Total column (printed blank), so transfers_in/out are null. Debt service is printed as one combined line (p4); split into principal 800,000 and interest/fees 545,598 using the debt fund schedules (p15-17). Detail: used the individual fund budget-and-actual schedules (p9-20), the most detailed schedules, and dropped the General Fund Components combining schedule (p6-7) and Nonmajor Funds combining schedule (p8) to avoid double counting. General Fund spending is by program (no object breakdown), so detail_category is not itemized; program lines add up to 11,958,020 and, with 8000 Transfers 90,000, to the printed total 12,048,020 (p13). Hidden transfer: line 4700 Building improvements 411,796 includes the 250,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (eliminated in the Reclassifications column on p7); split into 161,796 spending and a -250,000 other financing item (review), and the Depreciation Fund shows +250,000 transfer in; so the General Fund expenditure items plus the 340,000 of transfers out equal 12,048,020. The state/federal programs reclassification to Instruction on p7 (389,204) is a function reclass only; General Fund state/federal programs were left as printed and categorized as instruction. Budget-only lines with no actual (1990 Other local receipts 4,000; 4530 Other federal categorical receipts 25,000; Bond Fund principal payments 2,400,000; QCPU interest 600) omitted. Header budget amounts on group heading lines (e.g. Support services - students 710,000) not recorded. School Nutrition Salaries row prints budget 503,454 equal to the total budget, so budget_final left null for that line. General Fund revenue lines tie to 12,798,868 (p10). Printed total assets 23,053,385 vs total net position/fund balances 23,053,384 (rounding, recorded in report_discrepancies). Read pages 1-20 of 20.
